coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 11 ground-truth variables (27%): comparison of ZB-2p with a theoretical schedule, ideal communication overlap, and measured bubble rate. Other variables are missing, only partially represented, or configured differently.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses 7B/70B models rather than the specified 14.6B architecture, varies pipeline depth instead of fixing 16 stages, and varies microbatch counts instead of fixing 64. The 2p scheduling option partially matches the memory constraint but does not preserve the specified fixed flag configuration. Nsight profiling is included, but nsys export and custom Python/SVG processing are absent. MFU replaces samples/second/GPU throughput, and aggregate theoretical-gap analysis does not measure computed-versus-profiled stage-timeline alignment. Numerous additional experimental factors change the intended controlled design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected near-zero bubble result (less than 1% in most settings), minor real-execution overheads, and supporting high throughput and tight timeline alignment.
